person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: the composition of the healthy human gut microbiota, and whether a single optimal one exists
span.quote: This review aims to define what would be the optimal gut microbiota composition in order to maintain these optimal microbiota immune and metabolic functions.

span.label: what would be the optimal gut microbiota composition for maintaining immune and metabolic function
span.quote: This review aims to define what would be the optimal gut microbiota composition in order to maintain these optimal microbiota immune and metabolic functions.

span.label: a review named after a question about a norm, which answers it in the negative: richness and diversity characterise a healthy composition, but the optimal composition is different for every individual
span.quote: Richness and diversity of gut microbiota shaped in early life characterize a healthy gut microbiota composition. However, this optimal healthy gut microbiota composition is different for each individual.

span.label: existence
span.quote: These personal and healthy core native microbiota remain relatively stable in adulthood but differ between individuals due to enterotypes, body mass index (BMI) level, exercise frequency, lifestyle, and cultural and dietary habits. Accordingly, there is not a unique optimal gut microbiota composition since it is different for each individual.

span.label: gut microbiota composition varies within one person over life and between people, while its FUNCTIONS are highly preserved across people
span.quote: It is paradoxical to note that the gut microbiota functions are highly preserved between individuals, whereas each individual’s gut microbiota are characterized by a specific combination of bacterial species due to inter-individual and intra-individual variations throughout human life.

span.label: narrative review of composition studies, with the taxonomic variation between and within individuals tabulated
span.term: narrative review of composition studies, with the taxonomic variation between and within individuals tabulated
span.quote: The majority of these techniques are based on the extraction of DNA and the amplification of the 16S ribosomal RNA gene (rRNA) \ [5, 6\]. 16S rRNA sequencing has become the most useful technique to highlight diversity and abundance of the microbiome.

span.label: the core native microbiota are set in the first 4-36 months by gestational age, mode of delivery, milk feeding, weaning, lifestyle and diet, and are relatively stable from age 2-3
span.quote: Core native microbiota are shaped in early life (4–36 months) by gut maturation developing from enterotype, birth gestational age, type of delivery, methods of milk feeding, weaning period, lifestyle, and dietary and cultural habits. After a child reaches 2–3 years old, a relative stability in gut microbiota composition has been demonstrated.

span.label: richness and diversity are what let the ecosystem withstand external threats - unbalanced diet, stress, antibiotics, disease
span.quote: Throughout life, the richer and more diverse the microbiota, the better they will withstand external threats. Indeed, gut microbiota represent a changing ecosystem that is severely tested by many factors such as unbalanced diet, stress, antibiotic use, or diseases.

span.label: THE PAPER'S TITLE ASKS FOR A NORM AND ITS ANSWER IS THAT THERE IS NONE: there is no unique optimal gut microbiota composition, because it differs for each individual - while `dysbiosis`, defined by departure from that composition, continues to be used
span.quote: These personal and healthy core native microbiota remain relatively stable in adulthood but differ between individuals due to enterotypes, body mass index (BMI) level, exercise frequency, lifestyle, and cultural and dietary habits. Accordingly, there is not a unique optimal gut microbiota composition since it is different for each individual.

span.label: whether the microbiota balances are the CAUSE or the CONSEQUENCE of disease is explicitly unresolved, and the therapeutic proposal rests on resolving it
span.quote: Understanding the cause or consequence of these gut microbiota balances in health and disease and how to maintain or restore a healthy gut microbiota composition should be useful in developing promising therapeutic interventions.

span.label: the role of gut microbiota is stated by the authors to be still poorly understood, in the same sentence that proposes dysbiosis as a biomarker
span.quote: Although the role of gut microbiota is still poorly understood, the close association between gut microbiota dysbiosis and intestinal and extra-intestinal disorders has been demonstrated. This is the reason why dysbiosis can be considered as a biomarker of such disorders and that the study of gut microbiota balances shall be one of the priorities for future therapies to prevent and treat diseases.

span.label: the field's foundational difficulty was that these organisms could not be cultured, so the composition literature rests on 16S rRNA sequencing of DNA from stools rather than on the organisms themselves
span.quote: For years, scientists have been interested in gut microbiota, but one of the major difficulties in the relevant research has been the ability to culture these microorganisms

span.label: resilience to antibiotic disturbance varies considerably across individuals, so a population-level statement about recovery does not transfer to a person
span.quote: The impact of antibiotic disturbance on the resilience of microbiota during future antibiotic treatments can thus also vary considerably across individuals

span.label: `superorganism`, an ecological and evolutionary term for a colony treated as one individual, applied to a human plus their resident microbes
span.quote: Considering the characteristics of gut microbiota such as the large diversity, the stability and resilience, and the symbiotic interaction with the host, we can define the host and the microorganisms inhabiting it as a “superorganism” \ [8, 9\] which performs immune and metabolic functions

span.label: microbiota variation is reported WITHIN the same individual as well as BETWEEN individuals, so a between-person difference is not read as a change
span.note: eliminates: inter-individual variation being reported as the effect of an exposure · outcome: held
span.quote: It is paradoxical to note that the gut microbiota functions are highly preserved between individuals, whereas each individual’s gut microbiota are characterized by a specific combination of bacterial species due to inter-individual and intra-individual variations throughout human life.

span.label: the direction of the microbiota-disease association is left open rather than asserted
span.note: would have ruled out, had it been run: an association being published as a cause
span.quote: Understanding the cause or consequence of these gut microbiota balances in health and disease and how to maintain or restore a healthy gut microbiota composition should be useful in developing promising therapeutic interventions.

span.label: gut microbiota
span.quote: The human gastrointestinal (GI) tract contains an abundant and diverse microbial community that gathers more than 100 trillion microorganisms

span.label: enterotype
span.quote: Gut microbiota of each individual are specifically characterized by clusters of bacteria named enterotypes \ [13\]. Three enterotypes are characterized by three dominant bacteria clusters ( Table 2): _Bacteroides_ (enterotype I), _Prevotella_ (enterotype II), or _Ruminococcus_ (enterotype III).

span.label: blood groups
span.quote: Every enterotype is not a clear-cut identity such as blood groups; however, enterotypes characterize individuals, remain stable from adulthood, and can be restored if they are modified.

span.label: bacteria species
span.quote: Gut microbiota are composed of different bacteria species taxonomically classified by genus, family, order, and phyla.

span.label: dysbiosis
span.quote: Indeed, dysbiosis of gut microbiota is associated not only with intestinal disorders but also with numerous extra-intestinal diseases such as metabolic and neurological disorders.

span.label: superorganism
span.quote: Considering the characteristics of gut microbiota such as the large diversity, the stability and resilience, and the symbiotic interaction with the host, we can define the host and the microorganisms inhabiting it as a “superorganism” \ [8, 9\] which performs immune and metabolic functions

span.label: diversity
span.quote: Throughout life, the richer and more diverse the microbiota, the better they will withstand external threats. Indeed, gut microbiota represent a changing ecosystem that is severely tested by many factors such as unbalanced diet, stress, antibiotic use, or diseases.

span.label: healthy gut microbiota composition - AS USED HERE: characterised by richness and diversity shaped in early life, and NOT a single composition, because the optimum is different for each individual
span.quote: Richness and diversity of gut microbiota shaped in early life characterize a healthy gut microbiota composition. However, this optimal healthy gut microbiota composition is different for each individual.

span.label: enterotype - a functional harmonious association of bacterial species, not a systematic addition of them, and EXPLICITLY NOT a clear-cut identity in the way a blood group is
span.quote: These three enterotypes are not only enumerations of bacteria; they are also specifically regrouped by functions. Indeed, an enterotype is a functional harmonious association of several bacteria species rather than a systematic addition of bacteria species.

span.label: native core microbiota - the profile of a full-term, vaginally delivered, breastfed infant whose mother's milk microbiota is balanced; `healthy` is defined here by PROVENANCE rather than by composition
span.quote: These studies have shown that native core microbiota are shaped during early life: the profile of intestinal microbiota in the full-term, vaginally delivered, and breastfed infant with healthy and balanced mother’s milk microbiota is considered healthy.

span.label: critiques → the search for a single optimal gut microbiota composition, on the ground that the optimum differs for every individual
span.quote: These personal and healthy core native microbiota remain relatively stable in adulthood but differ between individuals due to enterotypes, body mass index (BMI) level, exercise frequency, lifestyle, and cultural and dietary habits. Accordingly, there is not a unique optimal gut microbiota composition since it is different for each individual.

span.label: extends → the dysbiosis literature, by proposing dysbiosis as a BIOMARKER of disorders while stating that the role of gut microbiota is still poorly understood
span.quote: Although the role of gut microbiota is still poorly understood, the close association between gut microbiota dysbiosis and intestinal and extra-intestinal disorders has been demonstrated. This is the reason why dysbiosis can be considered as a biomarker of such disorders and that the study of gut microbiota balances shall be one of the priorities for future therapies to prevent and treat diseases.
